note: Wallets that must never count as external users. (1) Playwright E2E smoke wallets — random throwaway keypairs generated by CI/local smoke runs on 2026-07-29, before the app learned to skip on-chain registration under the injected test signer. (2) Our own passkey wallets from the 2026-08-04 end-to-end tour, which registered like any user would. user-count.mjs prunes them from the snapshot and ignores their future registrations.
